title: Labour–Fabian public register
tagline: A sourced directory of Labour public office-holders with a documented relationship to the Fabian Society.
limitations: The Fabian Society does not publish a complete membership list. This register only includes people for whom a named Fabian role, an explicit membership statement, or a published Fabian pamphlet/essay can be cited from a public URL.
The society’s 2024–25 annual report said 141 Fabian MPs were elected in July 2024. That list was not published. Those unnamed MPs are not invented here.
Writing a pamphlet or speaking at a Fabian event is not the same as membership. People included only as authors are labelled as such and are excluded from the ‘named role or membership’ count.
Wikipedia is treated as a lead, never as the sole source.
Donation and register-of-interests coverage is incomplete. Where a figure was not copied from an official record, the field is left blank.
This is not an official Fabian Society or Labour Party list.
